ideas.title: CGM Data Aggregator API
ideas.description: A unified API that connects to Dexcom, Libre, and Medtronic CGM systems. Developers could build apps without dealing with each proprietary API. Charge per API call.
ideas.notes: Could be the foundation for AvaDrive and other diabetes apps. You already have Dexcom working - expand to others.

ideas.title: Mobile Home Service Marketplace
ideas.description: Like Thumbtack but specifically for manufactured home services - setup crews, leveling, skirting, plumbing. Connect homeowners with vetted contractors.
ideas.notes: Natural extension of FieldSync. You already understand the industry pain points from the inside.

ideas.title: Diabetes Camp Simulation Mode
ideas.description: Partner with diabetes camps to use AVA Type 1 as a training tool. Kids practice management in accelerated time before going on real pumps.
ideas.notes: B2B revenue stream for the AVA app. Camps would pay for licenses.

ideas.title: NFC Sticker Packs for AVA
ideas.description: Physical NFC stickers kids can scan to trigger in-game events (eating food, exercise, etc.). Sell as expansion packs. Makes the game tangible.
ideas.notes: Low cost to produce, high margin. Creates physical product line alongside app.

ideas.title: FieldSync → QuickBooks Integration
ideas.description: Auto-generate invoices from completed walkthroughs. Sync materials costs. Time tracking for hourly billing. Contractors would pay for this.
ideas.notes: This is where the money is in FieldSync. Accounting integration = premium tier.

ideas.title: Warranty Claim Automation
ideas.description: AI reads walkthrough notes and photos, auto-fills manufacturer warranty claim forms. Saves hours per claim. Sell to service companies.
ideas.notes: This is a huge pain point you experience directly. Could integrate with FieldSync or standalone.

ideas.title: AVA Arcade - Mini Games Collection
ideas.description: Standalone app with diabetes-themed mini games from AVA Type 1. Free with ads, or bundle with main app.

ideas.title: Service Tech Training Platform
ideas.description: Video courses + certification for manufactured home service technicians. Partner with manufacturers for official certs.
ideas.notes: Industry has no standardized training. First mover could own this space.

ideas.title: AVA Home — Matter Smart Bulb CGM Alerts
ideas.description: Connect CGM glucose data to Matter-compatible smart home devices via Apple HomeKit. Flash lights red for lows, yellow for highs. Visual alerts you can't miss even when phone is in another room. Huge for nighttime lows — bedroom light flashes, harder to sleep through than phone buzzing.
ideas.notes: HomeKit API is straightforward (difficulty 3/10). Could be a feature of AvaDrive, AVA Heart, or standalone AVA Home module. Reference bulb: OREiN Matter Smart Bulb 4-pack (https://a.co/d/5kKmDSp). Supports Apple Home, Alexa, Google, SmartThings.

ideas.title: T1D Benefits Navigator
ideas.description: App that matches T1D families with patient assistance programs (PAPs) based on income, insurance status, and medication/supply needs. Input info once, see which programs you qualify for, pre-fill applications. Nobody does this well today.
ideas.notes: ✅ BUILT: Full production PWA deployed to https://t1d-benefits-navigator.pages.dev. Comprehensive PAP database with 30+ programs, smart eligibility scoring, application guidance, installable PWA. React + Vite + Tailwind stack. GitHub: https://github.com/ava-type1/t1d-benefits-navigator
